dataset_limitations.scientific_integrity_status: Starter research pack and empty schema templates. NOT a complete incident-level training dataset.
dataset_limitations.blank_value_interpretation: CRITICAL: Blank values in templates denote unknown / unpopulated / not-yet-sourced entries. They MUST NEVER be interpreted, parsed, or imputed as zero.
dataset_limitations.ml_training_readiness: NOT READY for supervised machine-learning incident classification or mortality regression. Training on blank templates or annual aggregate totals is mathematically invalid and produces spurious models.
dataset_limitations.synthetic_data_prohibition: No incident records, GPS coordinates, victim profiles, or timestamps have been fabricated or synthesized.
dataset_limitations.privacy_protection: Schema excludes personal names, phone numbers, addresses, and individual identifiers in compliance with ethical research guidelines.
dataset_limitations.macro_statistics_disclaimer: NCRB ADSI statistics (2018-2024) are annual state-level aggregates. They do NOT contain micro-level incident coordinates, exact timestamps, or victim identifiers. They MUST NOT be used to train incident-level predictive machine-learning models.

start_here.csv.description: Starter pack overview, scope, research principles, and ethical warnings against training on blank templates.

district_year_template.csv.description: Structured template covering all 14 Kerala districts across 8 years (2018–2025). Metrics are currently blank with status NOT_YET_SOURCED, awaiting extraction from official ADSI tables.

incident_registry.csv.description: Empty schema specification for future geolocated micro-incident recording (date, time, exact coordinates, waterbody, outcome, weather/hydrology coupling, verification status).

hydrology_observations.csv.description: Empty schema specification for recording high-frequency in-situ hydrological telemetry (stage, rainfall, discharge) paired with verified incident timestamps.

waterbody_inventory.csv.description: Empty schema specification for cataloging site-level physical characteristics (bathymetry, depth, flow velocity) and safety infrastructure (barriers, warning signs, lifebuoys).

sourced_context.csv.description: Verified official historical statistics from MoHFW/DGHS citing NCRB: National annual drowning deaths (2018–2022: 30,178 to 38,503/year) and Kerala state total for 2022 (1,419 deaths).

source_register.csv.description: Authoritative register of 9 primary data sources (S1 to S9) with verified government URLs and recommended research applications.

ncrb_statistics/Kerala_ADSI_Drowning_Sta.description: Annual Kerala state drowning totals (2018-2024) from official NCRB ADSI publications (Table 1.9 for 2018-2019, Table 1.10 for 2020-2024). Preserves cases, injuries, deaths, and male/female/transgender breakdowns.

ncrb_statistics/Kerala_ADSI_Drowning_Cat.description: Disaggregated accidental drowning categories across 7 years (Total, Boat Capsize, Accidental Falls into Waterbody, Other Cases) with full gender distribution for injuries and fatalities, NCRB case codes (10008-10011), and source tables.

ncrb_statistics/Kerala_ADSI_Category_Val.description: Internal mathematical verification records confirming that reported Total identically matches the sum of sub-categories (Boat Capsize + Accidental Falls + Other Cases) across cases, injuries, and deaths with 0 difference.

ncrb_statistics/Kerala_ADSI_Sources_and_.description: Official publication references, table numbers, source files, and repository provenance notes for each annual extraction (2018-2024).

ncrb_statistics/Kerala_ADSI_Drowning_Sta.description: Primary master multi-tab spreadsheet preserving complete NCRB accidental death extracts for Kerala.
